usage: 熱檸茶 is a noun used to refer to a specific type of drink served hot with lemon flavor.
You can use 熱檸茶 as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, 'I want 熱檸茶' or '熱檸茶 is delicious.'
It does not change form for singular or plural, so '熱檸茶' refers to one or any number of cups of hot lemon tea.
When ordering, you can combine 熱檸茶 with verbs like '想飲' (want to drink) or '飲' (drink).
You can also use adjectives with 熱檸茶, such as '好飲' (tasty) or '好熱' (very hot).
